title: A second office for a sixty-person software company
prompt: Choose a city for our second office from Denver, Raleigh, Austin, and Salt Lake City; we're a 60-person software company.
note: A serif title on a wider measure, because the reader is a leadership team looking at it on a conference room screen, and a slim brand band for the winner rather than a card so the grid gets the space. Criteria are rows with their weight as a numeric column and the four cities as columns, totals in a bold bottom row, and the ranked totals as bars beside the table; three preset buttons re-total the grid and re-rank the bars with a few lines of script, while the balanced weighting is printed in the markup and the sensitivity prose carries every preset's result for a reader with scripts off.
